noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local instance] Fintype.ofFinite

abbrev AmbientFunctionals {d : ℕ} :=
  (Fin d → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2

abbrev FunctionalsAt {d : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) :=
  {psi : AmbientFunctionals (d := d) // psi v = 1}

abbrev RestrictedFunctionals {d : ℕ} (A : Submodule (ZMod 2)
    (Fin d → ZMod 2)) (v : A) :=
  {phi : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2 // phi v = 1}

def actualA18RankOne {n d : ℕ}
    (psi : AmbientFunctionals (d := d)) (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) :
    BinaryMatrix n d :=
  LinearMap.toMatrix' (psi.smulRight w)

theorem actualA18RankOne_entry {n d : ℕ}
    (psi : AmbientFunctionals (d := d)) (w : Fin n → ZMod 2)
    (i : Fin n) (j : Fin d) :
    actualA18RankOne psi w i j = w i * psi (Pi.single j 1) := by
  simp [actualA18RankOne, LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply,
    LinearMap.smulRight_apply, mul_comm]

theorem toMatrix'_add_rankOne {n d : ℕ}
    (F : (Fin d → ZMod 2) →ₗ[ZMod 2] (Fin n → ZMod 2))
    (psi : AmbientFunctionals (d := d)) (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix' (F + psi.smulRight w) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix' F + actualA18RankOne psi w := by
  ext i j
  simp [actualA18RankOne, LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply, add_comm, mul_comm]

/-- The ambient functional draw is exactly a dependent draw of a restricted
functional and its uniform quotient extension coordinate, independently of
the row vector. -/
noncomputable def globalFunctionalRowEquiv {n d : ℕ}
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin d → ZMod 2)) (v : A) :
    (FunctionalsAt (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) × (Fin n → ZMod 2)) ≃
      RestrictedFunctionals A v ×
        ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) ×
          (Fin n → ZMod 2) := by
  classical
  let e := globalFunctionalRestrictionEquiv A v
  refine
    { toFun := fun p =>
        let z := e p.1
        (z.1, z.2, p.2)
      invFun := fun p => (e.symm ⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩, p.2.2)
      left_inv := ?_
      right_inv := ?_ }
  · intro p
    rcases p with ⟨psi, w⟩
    simp [e]
  · intro p
    rcases p with ⟨phi, lambda, w⟩
    simp [e]

/-- Normalized sums over the ambient `(psi,w)` draw and the dependent
restricted-functional/quotient-coordinate draw agree for every statistic. -/
theorem globalFunctionalRow_average_reindex {n d : ℕ}
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin d → ZMod 2)) (v : A)
    (g : FunctionalsAt (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) × (Fin n → ZMod 2) → ℂ)
    (g' : RestrictedFunctionals A v ×
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) ×
        (Fin n → ZMod 2) → ℂ)
    (hpoint : ∀ p, g p = g' (globalFunctionalRowEquiv A v p)) :
    (∑ p, g p) /
        (Fintype.card (FunctionalsAt (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) ×
          (Fin n → ZMod 2)) : ℂ) =
      (∑ p, g' p) /
        (Fintype.card (RestrictedFunctionals A v ×
          ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) ×
            (Fin n → ZMod 2)) : ℂ) := by
  classical
  let e := globalFunctionalRowEquiv (n := n) A v
  have hsum : (∑ p, g p) = ∑ p, g' p := by
    calc
      (∑ p, g p) = ∑ p, g' (e p) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        exact hpoint p
      _ = ∑ p, g' p := Equiv.sum_comp e g'
  have hcard : Fintype.card (FunctionalsAt (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) ×
      (Fin n → ZMod 2)) =
    Fintype.card (RestrictedFunctionals A v ×
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) ×
        (Fin n → ZMod 2)) := Fintype.card_congr e
  rw [hsum, hcard]

/-- In the quotient coordinates, the source sample is literally the parent
actual-fibre matrix plus the rank-one matrix drawn from the ambient
functional and row vector. This is the pointwise identity required before
any Jensen or finite-law reindexing. -/
theorem actualA18_sourceSample_eq_ambient
    {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (R : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      Q.codomainVariation)
    (lambda : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) :
    let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
    let qdom : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2]
        ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) :=
      Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
        intro x hx
        rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact a.property)
    let hcoords := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
      Q.domainFixed phi v hv
    let phi₀ := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec hcoords)
    let psi := (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv) lambda
    LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀ R lambda w).comp
            (Submodule.mkQ A')) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
            (R.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ)) +
        actualA18RankOne psi.1 w := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let qdom : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let hcoords := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec hcoords)
  let psi := (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv Q.domainFixed phi v hv) lambda
  have hpsi : psi.1 =
      phi₀.comp (Submodule.mkQ A') + lambda.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ := by
    change restrictedFunctionalReference Q.domainFixed phi v hv +
      lambda.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ =
        phi₀.comp (Submodule.mkQ A') + lambda.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ
    congr 1
  have hA' : A' ≤ Q.domainFixed := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact a.property
  have hsource := quotientSampleOutput_eq_parent_add_line
    (K := ZMod 2) (X := Fin d → ZMod 2) (X' := Fin d → ZMod 2)
    (W := Fin n → ZMod 2)
    A' Q.domainFixed hA' Q.codomainVariation phi₀ R lambda w
  have hline :
      (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀ R lambda w).comp
          (Submodule.mkQ A') =
        Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
            (R.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ) + psi.1.smulRight w := by
    simpa [A', qdom, phi₀, psi, restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv,
      restrictedFunctionalReference] using hsource
  change LinearMap.toMatrix'
      (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
        (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀ R lambda w).comp
          (Submodule.mkQ A')) =
    LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
          (R.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ)) + actualA18RankOne psi.1 w
  calc
    LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀ R lambda w).comp
            (Submodule.mkQ A')) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
          (Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
            (R.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ) + psi.1.smulRight w)) := by
        exact congrArg (fun F => LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + F))
          hline
    _ = LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (Matrix.toLin' Q.base + Q.codomainVariation.subtype.comp
            (R.comp Q.domainFixed.mkQ)) + actualA18RankOne psi.1 w := by
        rw [← add_assoc]
        exact toMatrix'_add_rankOne _ _ _

end

namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18FullFunctionalEnergy

def actualA18Average {n d : ℕ} (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ) (M : BinaryMatrix n d) : ℂ :=
  (∑ p : FunctionalsAt v × (Fin n → ZMod 2),
    f (M + actualA18RankOne p.1.1 p.2)) /
      (Fintype.card (FunctionalsAt v × (Fin n → ZMod 2)) : ℂ)

/-- Nonzero directions have an ambient functional taking value one, hence the
restricted-functional fibre used by the A18 reindexing is nonempty. -/
theorem restrictedFunctionals_nonempty_of_ne_zero {d : ℕ}
    (A : Submodule (ZMod 2) (Fin d → ZMod 2)) (v : A)
    (hv : (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (RestrictedFunctionals A v) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨psi, hpsi⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one (ZMod 2) hv
  refine ⟨⟨psi.comp A.subtype, ?_⟩⟩
  simpa using hpsi

noncomputable def actualA18SourceSample {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (R : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      Q.codomainVariation)
    (lambda : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) : BinaryMatrix n d :=
  let A' := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi
  let qdom : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A') →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) :=
    Submodule.factor (p := A') (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
      intro x hx
      rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact a.property)
  let hcoords := quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
    Q.domainFixed phi v hv
  let phi₀ := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec hcoords)
  LinearMap.toMatrix' (Matrix.toLin' Q.base +
    (quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation qdom phi₀ R lambda w).comp
      (Submodule.mkQ A'))

theorem actualA18SourceSample_eq_base_add {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (R : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      Q.codomainVariation)
    (lambda : ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed) →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)
    (w : Fin n → ZMod 2) :
    actualA18SourceSample Q phi v hv R lambda w =
      Q.base + LinearMap.toMatrix'
        ((quotientSampleOutput Q.codomainVariation
          (Submodule.factor (p := functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi)
            (p' := Q.domainFixed) (by
              intro x hx
              rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
              exact a.property))
          (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
            (quotientSectionCoordinates_of_restricted_functional
              Q.domainFixed phi v hv))) R lambda w).comp
          (Submodule.mkQ (functionalKernelInAmbient Q.domainFixed phi))) := by
  simp [actualA18SourceSample, LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin']

/-- The exact source-coordinate line mean used by the fixed-functional
all-columns estimate. -/
noncomputable def actualA18SourceLineMean {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (v : Q.domainFixed)
    (phi : RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v)
    (R : QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation)
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (∑ p : (Fin n → ZMod 2) ×
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2),
    f (actualA18SourceSample Q phi.1 v phi.2 R p.2 p.1)) /
    (Fintype.card ((Fin n → ZMod 2) ×
      ((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2)) : ℂ)

theorem complex_product_average_eq_iterated
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (z : α × β → ℂ) :
    (∑ p : α × β, z p) / (Fintype.card (α × β) : ℂ) =
    (∑ a : α, (∑ b : β, z (a, b)) / (Fintype.card β : ℂ)) /
        (Fintype.card α : ℂ) := by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  simp [div_div, mul_comm]

/-- Pointwise reindexing of the *actual* `(psi,w)` operator at each matrix in
the parent fibre.  The sample identity transports its matrix to the source
quotient coordinates without changing the statistic. -/
theorem actualA18Average_eq_sourceCoordinates {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (v : Q.domainFixed)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (R : (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2]
      Q.codomainVariation)
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ) :
    actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f
        ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm R).1 =
      (∑ p : RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v ×
          (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) ×
            (Fin n → ZMod 2)),
        f (actualA18SourceSample Q p.1.1 v p.1.2 R p.2.1 p.2.2)) /
        (Fintype.card (RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v ×
          (((Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) ×
            (Fin n → ZMod 2))) : ℂ) := by
  classical
  let A := Q.domainFixed
  let B := Q.codomainVariation
  let W := Fin n → ZMod 2
  let Lambda := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2
  let G := FunctionalsAt (v : Fin d → ZMod 2)
  let Phi := RestrictedFunctionals A v
  let Rtype := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ A →ₗ[ZMod 2] B
  let parent := ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm R).1
  let g : G × W → ℂ := fun p =>
    f (parent + actualA18RankOne p.1.1 p.2)
  let g' : Phi × (Lambda × W) → ℂ := fun p =>
    f (actualA18SourceSample Q p.1.1 v p.1.2 R p.2.1 p.2.2)
  have hpoint : ∀ p, g p = g' (globalFunctionalRowEquiv A v p) := by
    intro p
    let e := globalFunctionalRestrictionEquiv A v
    let z := e p.1
    have hpsi' : p.1.1 =
        (restrictedFunctionalExtensionEquiv A z.1.1 v z.1.2 z.2).1 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : G => q.1) (e.left_inv p.1)
      dsimp [e, z, globalFunctionalRestrictionEquiv] at h
      exact h.symm
    have hmatrix := actualA18_sourceSample_eq_ambient Q z.1.1 v z.1.2
      R z.2 p.2
    have hparent := actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_symm_matrix Q R
    have hpointMatrix :
        parent + actualA18RankOne p.1.1 p.2 =
          actualA18SourceSample Q z.1.1 v z.1.2 R z.2 p.2 := by
      dsimp [parent]
      rw [hparent]
      rw [hpsi']
      exact hmatrix.symm
    dsimp [g, g']
    have hidx : globalFunctionalRowEquiv A v p =
        (z.1, (z.2, p.2)) := rfl
    rw [hidx]
    apply congrArg f
    simpa [hpsi'] using hpointMatrix
  simpa [actualA18Average, g, g', A, B, W, Lambda, G, Phi, Rtype] using
    globalFunctionalRow_average_reindex A v g g' hpoint

/-- After reindexing the actual ambient draw, its normalized mean is the
restricted-functional average of the source line means. The inner row and
quotient-functional coordinates are only permuted, with no change to the
statistic or its uniform law. -/
theorem actualA18Average_eq_average_sourceLineMean {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (v : Q.domainFixed)
    (phi : Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (hv : phi v = 1)
    (R : QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation)
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ) :
    actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f
        ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm R).1 =
      (∑ phi' : RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v,
        actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi' R f) /
        (Fintype.card (RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v) : ℂ) := by
  classical
  let Phi := RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v
  let Lambda := (Fin d → ZMod 2) ⧸ Q.domainFixed →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2
  let W := Fin n → ZMod 2
  let e : Phi × (Lambda × W) ≃ Phi × (W × Lambda) :=
    Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl Phi) (Equiv.prodComm Lambda W)
  let g : Phi × (Lambda × W) → ℂ := fun p =>
    f (actualA18SourceSample Q p.1.1 v p.1.2 R p.2.1 p.2.2)
  let g' : Phi × (W × Lambda) → ℂ := fun p =>
    f (actualA18SourceSample Q p.1.1 v p.1.2 R p.2.2 p.2.1)
  have hsum : (∑ p, g p) = ∑ p, g' p := by
    calc
      (∑ p, g p) = ∑ p, g' (e p) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rcases p with ⟨phi', lambda, w⟩
        rfl
      _ = ∑ p, g' p := Equiv.sum_comp e g'
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Phi × (Lambda × W)) =
      Fintype.card (Phi × (W × Lambda)) := Fintype.card_congr e
  rw [actualA18Average_eq_sourceCoordinates Q v phi hv R f]
  rw [hsum, hcard, complex_product_average_eq_iterated]
  simp [actualA18SourceLineMean, Phi, Lambda, W, g, g']

/-- Jensen over the restricted functional at each actual quotient map R. -/
theorem actualA18Average_normSq_le_sourceMean {n d : ℕ}
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) ≠ 0)
    (R : QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation)
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq (actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f
      ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm R).1) ≤
      (∑ phi : RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v,
        Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi R f)) /
        (Fintype.card (RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v) : ℝ) := by
  classical
  let Phi := RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v
  have hPhi : Nonempty Phi := restrictedFunctionals_nonempty_of_ne_zero
    Q.domainFixed v hv
  letI : Nonempty Phi := hPhi
  rw [actualA18Average_eq_average_sourceLineMean Q v
    (Classical.choice hPhi).1 (Classical.choice hPhi).2 R f]
  exact normSq_finite_average_le
    (fun phi : Phi => actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi R f)

/-- The normalized complex product mean is controlled by the average of the
per-first-coordinate normalized means in squared norm. -/
theorem normSq_complex_product_average_le
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    [Fintype β] [Nonempty β] (z : α × β → ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq
        ((∑ p : α × β, z p) / (Fintype.card (α × β) : ℂ)) ≤
      (∑ a : α,
        Complex.normSq
          ((∑ b : β, z (a, b)) / (Fintype.card β : ℂ))) /
        (Fintype.card α : ℝ) := by
  rw [complex_product_average_eq_iterated]
  exact normSq_finite_average_le
    (fun a : α => (∑ b : β, z (a, b)) / (Fintype.card β : ℂ))

/-- The two normalized finite real sums can be exchanged without changing
their value. -/
theorem real_finite_mean_swap {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (z : α × β → ℝ) :
    ((∑ b : β, (∑ a : α, z (a, b)) / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) /
        (Fintype.card β : ℝ)) =
      ((∑ a : α, (∑ b : β, z (a, b)) / (Fintype.card β : ℝ)) /
        (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_comm]
  ring

/-- Averaging the accepted fixed-functional line-energy estimate over all
restrictions of the ambient functional preserves the same `2 * eta` bound.
The nonzero direction supplies nonemptiness internally. -/
theorem actualA18_source_restricted_mean_energy_le_two
    {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) ≠ 0) :
    (∑ phi : RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v,
      (∑ R : QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation,
        Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi R f)) /
        (Fintype.card (QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation) : ℝ)) /
      (Fintype.card (RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v) : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
  classical
  let Phi := RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v
  let R := QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation
  have hPhi : Nonempty Phi := restrictedFunctionals_nonempty_of_ne_zero
    Q.domainFixed v hv
  letI : Nonempty Phi := hPhi
  have hcardPhi : 0 < (Fintype.card Phi : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hpoint (phi : Phi) :
      (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
        (Fintype.card R : ℝ) ≤ 2 * η := by
    simpa [actualA18SourceLineMean, actualA18SourceSample,
      actualA18SourceSample_eq_base_add, Phi, R] using
      actual_fixed_functional_line_average_energy_le_two
        f hf Q hQ phi.1 v phi.2
  have hsum :
      (∑ phi : Phi, (∑ r : R,
        Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
          (Fintype.card R : ℝ)) ≤
        ∑ _phi : Phi, 2 * η :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun phi hphi => hpoint phi)
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hcardPhi).2
  calc
    (∑ phi : Phi, (∑ r : R,
      Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
        (Fintype.card R : ℝ)) ≤
      ∑ _phi : Phi, 2 * η := hsum
    _ = (2 * η) * (Fintype.card Phi : ℝ) := by simp [mul_comm]

/-- The A18 operator has the required `2 * eta` energy on a parent actual
fibre whenever the sampled nonzero direction lies in its fixed subspace.
This combines the exact ambient functional reindexing, Jensen in the
restricted-functional coordinate, normalized finite-sum exchange, and the
accepted fixed-functional source bound. -/
theorem actualA18_parent_fibre_energy_le_two_inside {n d s : ℕ} {η : ℝ}
    (f : BinaryMatrix n d → ℂ)
    (hf : UpToActualNormSqGlobal s η f)
    (Q : ActualAffineRestriction n d) (hQ : Q.order ≤ s + 1)
    (v : Q.domainFixed) (hv : (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) ≠ 0) :
    fibreEnergy Q.fibre (actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f) ≤
      2 * η := by
  classical
  let Phi := RestrictedFunctionals Q.domainFixed v
  let R := QuotientHom Q.domainFixed Q.codomainVariation
  have hPhi : Nonempty Phi := restrictedFunctionals_nonempty_of_ne_zero
    Q.domainFixed v hv
  letI : Nonempty Phi := hPhi
  have hsource := actualA18_source_restricted_mean_energy_le_two
    f hf Q hQ v hv
  rw [actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv_energy]
  have hsum :
      (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq
        (actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f
          ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm r).1)) ≤
        ∑ r : R,
          (∑ phi : Phi,
            Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
              (Fintype.card Phi : ℝ) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r hr =>
      actualA18Average_normSq_le_sourceMean Q v hv r f)
  have hcardR : 0 < (Fintype.card R : ℝ) :=
    Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hnormalized :
      (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq
        (actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f
          ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm r).1)) /
        (Fintype.card R : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ r : R,
          (∑ phi : Phi,
            Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
              (Fintype.card Phi : ℝ)) /
        (Fintype.card R : ℝ) := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum (le_of_lt hcardR)
  have hswap := real_finite_mean_swap
    (α := Phi) (β := R)
    (fun p : Phi × R =>
      Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v p.1 p.2 f))
  calc
    (∑ r : R, Complex.normSq
      (actualA18Average (v : Fin d → ZMod 2) f
        ((actualFibreQuotientHomEquiv Q).symm r).1)) /
      (Fintype.card R : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ r : R,
          (∑ phi : Phi,
            Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
              (Fintype.card Phi : ℝ)) /
        (Fintype.card R : ℝ) := hnormalized
    _ = (∑ phi : Phi,
        (∑ r : R,
          Complex.normSq (actualA18SourceLineMean Q v phi r f)) /
            (Fintype.card R : ℝ)) /
          (Fintype.card Phi : ℝ) := hswap
    _ ≤ 2 * η := by
      simpa [Phi, R] using hsource
end
end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18FullFunctionalEnergy

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Exact scalar absorption estimates used by the outer A18 rank induction.
These bounds only normalize the manuscript's numerical constants. -/

namespace PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18InductionBounds

open scoped BigOperators

def a18BudgetScale (D r : Nat) (eps : Real) : Real :=
  (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r) * eps

/-- The top A17 contribution is at most `9/512` of the induction budget. -/
theorem a18_top_contribution_le_nine512
    {D r : Nat} {eps : Real} (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (heps : 0 ≤ eps) :
    2 * (2 : Real) ^ (10 * (D - 1) * (r - 1)) * eps +
      4 * (2 : Real) ^ (2 * D) * (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * (r - 1)) * eps ≤
        (9 / 512 : Real) * a18BudgetScale D r eps := by
  let d0 := D - 1
  let r0 := r - 1
  have hd0 : d0 + 1 = D := by dsimp [d0]; omega
  have hr0 : r0 + 1 = r := by dsimp [r0]; omega
  have hd0nonneg : 0 ≤ d0 := Nat.zero_le _
  have hr0nonneg : 0 ≤ r0 := Nat.zero_le _
  have hexp1 : 10 * d0 * r0 + 10 ≤ 10 * D * r := by
    rw [← hd0, ← hr0]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hd0nonneg hr0nonneg]
  have hexp2 : 2 * D + 10 * D * r0 + 8 ≤ 10 * D * r := by
    rw [← hd0, ← hr0]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hd0nonneg hr0nonneg]
  have hpow1 : (2 : Real) ^ (10 * d0 * r0 + 10) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hexp1
  have hpow2 : (2 : Real) ^ (2 * D + 10 * D * r0 + 8) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r) :=
    pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hexp2
  have hfirst : 2 * (2 : Real) ^ (10 * d0 * r0) * eps ≤
      a18BudgetScale D r eps / 512 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : Real) < 512)]
    calc
      (2 * (2 : Real) ^ (10 * d0 * r0) * eps) * 512 =
          (2 : Real) ^ (10 * d0 * r0 + 10) * eps := by
            norm_num [pow_add]
            ring
      _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r) * eps :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow1 heps
      _ = a18BudgetScale D r eps := by rfl
  have hsecond : 4 * (2 : Real) ^ (2 * D) *
      (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r0) * eps ≤
        a18BudgetScale D r eps / 64 := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : Real) < 64)]
    calc
      (4 * (2 : Real) ^ (2 * D) *
          (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r0) * eps) * 64 =
          (2 : Real) ^ (2 * D + 10 * D * r0 + 8) * eps := by
            norm_num [pow_add]
            ring
      _ ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (10 * D * r) * eps :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow2 heps
      _ = a18BudgetScale D r eps := by rfl
  calc
    _ ≤ a18BudgetScale D r eps / 512 +
          a18BudgetScale D r eps / 64 := add_le_add hfirst hsecond
    _ = (9 / 512 : Real) * a18BudgetScale D r eps := by ring

private theorem a18_geometric_sum_le {D r : Nat} (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) ≤
      (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31 := by
  induction D with
  | zero => simp
  | succ D ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have hq : (32 : Real) ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (5 * r) := by
        have he : 5 ≤ 5 * r := by omega
        calc
          (32 : Real) = 2 ^ 5 := by norm_num
          _ ≤ 2 ^ (5 * r) := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) he
      have hpow : (2 : Real) ^ (5 * (D + 1) * r) =
          (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) * (2 : Real) ^ (5 * r) := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      have hx : 0 ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) := by positivity
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) +
            (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) ≤
          (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31 +
            (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) := add_le_add ih le_rfl
        _ ≤ ((2 : Real) ^ (5 * r) / 31) *
            (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) := by
          nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq hx]
        _ = (2 : Real) ^ (5 * (D + 1) * r) / 31 := by rw [hpow]; ring

/-- The square of the sum of all lower-level square-root bounds is at most
`K/961`; this preserves the cross terms in the outer induction. -/
theorem a18_lower_levels_square_le
    {D r : Nat} {eps : Real} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) :
    ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) ^ 2) * eps ≤
      a18BudgetScale D r eps / 961 := by
  have hsum := a18_geometric_sum_le (D := D) hr
  have hsum_nonneg :
      0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r) := by
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi => by positivity
  have hsq :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) ^ 2 ≤
        ((2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31) ^ 2 := by
    have hright : 0 ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31 := by positivity
    have hsumPlus : 0 ≤
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) +
          (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31 := by linarith
    have hdiff : 0 ≤ (2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31 -
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) :=
      sub_nonneg.mpr hsum
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hsumPlus hdiff]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((2 : Real) ^ (5 * D * r) / 31) ^ 2 * eps :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq heps
    _ = a18BudgetScale D r eps / 961 := by
      simp only [div_pow]
      rw [← pow_mul]
      have hexp : 5 * D * r * 2 = 10 * D * r := by ring
      rw [hexp]
      norm_num [a18BudgetScale] <;> ring

/-- The manuscript's two lower-level contributions fit inside half of the
budget, including the zero-epsilon boundary case. -/
theorem a18_lower_absorption {D r : Nat} {eps : Real}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (heps : 0 ≤ eps) :
    a18BudgetScale D r eps / 2 +
      2 * (((∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (2 : Real) ^ (5 * i * r)) ^ 2) * eps) ≤
        a18BudgetScale D r eps := by
  have hlow := a18_lower_levels_square_le (D := D) hr heps
  have hK : 0 ≤ a18BudgetScale D r eps := by
    unfold a18BudgetScale
    positivity
  calc
    _ ≤ a18BudgetScale D r eps / 2 +
        2 * (a18BudgetScale D r eps / 961) := by
          exact add_le_add le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (by norm_num))
    _ ≤ a18BudgetScale D r eps := by
      have hc : (1 / 2 : Real) + 2 / 961 ≤ 1 := by norm_num
      calc
        a18BudgetScale D r eps / 2 +
            2 * (a18BudgetScale D r eps / 961) =
          ((1 / 2 : Real) + 2 / 961) * a18BudgetScale D r eps := by ring
        _ ≤ 1 * a18BudgetScale D r eps :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc hK
        _ = a18BudgetScale D r eps := by ring

/-- The normalized L2 size of a complex-valued function on a nonempty finite
uniform space. -/
noncomputable def a18UniformL2 {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (f : X → Complex) : Real :=
  Real.sqrt ((∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x)) / (Fintype.card X : Real))

private theorem a18_uniformL2_add_le {X : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (f g : X → Complex) :
    a18UniformL2 (fun x => f x + g x) ≤ a18UniformL2 f + a18UniformL2 g := by
  classical
  let N : Real := Fintype.card X
  have hN : 0 < N := by positivity
  have hraw := Real.Lp_add_le_of_nonneg (s := (Finset.univ : Finset X))
    (f := fun x => ‖f x‖) (g := fun x => ‖g x‖) (p := (2 : Real)) (by norm_num)
    (by intro x hx; exact norm_nonneg _) (by intro x hx; exact norm_nonneg _)
  have hraw' :
      Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, (‖f x‖ + ‖g x‖) ^ 2) ≤
        Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, ‖g x‖ ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [← Real.rpow_natCast, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hraw
  have hpoint : ∀ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x + g x) ≤
      (‖f x‖ + ‖g x‖) ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    rw [Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    have hn := norm_add_le (f x) (g x)
    have hn1 : 0 ≤ ‖f x + g x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hn0 : 0 ≤ ‖f x‖ + ‖g x‖ := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖f x + g x‖), sq_nonneg (‖f x‖ + ‖g x‖)]
  have hsum : (∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x + g x)) ≤
      ∑ x : X, (‖f x‖ + ‖g x‖) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => hpoint x
  have hsumf : 0 ≤ ∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _
  have hsumg : 0 ≤ ∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (g x) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _
  have hsumfg : 0 ≤ ∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x + g x) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _
  have hnormf : (∑ x : X, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = ∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    exact (Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq (z := f x)).symm
  have hnormg : (∑ x : X, ‖g x‖ ^ 2) = ∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (g x) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    exact (Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq (z := g x)).symm
  have hraw'' :
      Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x + g x)) ≤
        Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (f x)) +
          Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, Complex.normSq (g x)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ x : X, (‖f x‖ + ‖g x‖) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsum
      _ ≤ _ := by simpa only [hnormf, hnormg] using hraw'
  have hdiv (s : Real) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
      Real.sqrt (s / N) = Real.sqrt s / Real.sqrt N := Real.sqrt_div hs N
  unfold a18UniformL2
  rw [hdiv _ hsumfg, hdiv _ hsumf, hdiv _ hsumg]
  have hsqrtN : 0 < Real.sqrt N := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hN
  have hrawdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hraw'' (by positivity : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt N)
  simpa only [add_div] using hrawdiv

/-- Finite-sum Minkowski for normalized L2 on an arbitrary nonempty finite
uniform carrier. The level index set may be empty, so zero-energy boundaries
need no positivity assumption on any summand. -/
theorem a18_uniformL2_finset_sum_le {X I : Type*} [Fintype X] [Nonempty X]
    (s : Finset I) (g : I → X → Complex) :
    a18UniformL2 (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, g i x) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ s, a18UniformL2 (g i) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [a18UniformL2]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      have hsum : (fun x : X => ∑ j ∈ insert i s, g j x) =
          (fun x => g i x + ∑ j ∈ s, g j x) := by
        funext x
        rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      rw [hsum, Finset.sum_insert hi]
      exact (a18_uniformL2_add_le (g i) (fun x => ∑ j ∈ s, g j x)).trans
        (add_le_add le_rfl ih)

end PvNP.RealizableHardness.ActualBinaryMatrixHC46A18InductionBounds
